summary: Enterprise Suite AC-10 in-memory storage seam reference adapter records suite metadata with idempotency validation and duplicate-write refusal while explicitly avoiding durable storage/runtime-write claims.

findings: The adapter is a small BTreeMap/BTreeSet reference implementation with no provider configuration or hidden I/O.
Duplicate idempotency keys and malformed keys fail deterministically.
Separates storage seam behavior from durable provider wiring, matching repo port/adapter patterns.
Capability flags keep Postgres/RLS, cloud object store, runtime write path, and Workflow execution false until real adapters land.

findings: Positive storage of all suite metadata record kinds and negative duplicate/key-shape tests are covered.

alternatives_named: reuse cloud object storage provider adapters directly
add an in-memory storage seam reference first
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: In-memory reference pins idempotency and metadata record contracts without overclaiming durable storage or provider integration.
rejected_reasons: Postgres/RLS requires schema migrations, tenancy, rollback, and SLO evidence not present in this slice.
Cloud object storage is not the right primary metadata store for suite control-plane records.

findings: No secrets/provider credentials are introduced.
Idempotency key validation rejects empty, whitespace, path traversal, and duplicate keys.

F8_performance.regression_baseline: No durable backend exists; tests exercise fixed-size in-memory metadata records.

findings.summary: Operations are bounded by BTreeMap/BTreeSet key operations over in-process metadata; no network, filesystem, or database I/O is introduced.

findings: Stored-record and capability public fields carry data_class annotations.
Capability response explicitly marks durable backend, Postgres/RLS, cloud object store, runtime write path, and Workflow execution false.
The change is additive: one in-memory adapter crate, catalog row, workspace membership, spec/tasks/evidence updates, and no migrations or external resources.
Stored records carry topic, primary ref, idempotency key, schema version, payload data class, and backend label for future audit/telemetry labels.
Enterprise Suite AC-10 and D-07 record the storage seam while durable storage, runtime write path, Postgres/RLS, cloud provider, and SLO evidence remain future slices.

M1_challenge_assumption.premise_stated: A storage seam reference can land before durable storage if it is explicitly volatile and capability flags keep all provider/runtime write claims false.
M1_challenge_assumption.premise_evidence_ref: specs/microservices/enterprise-suite.json AC-10 and storage capability tests
M1_challenge_assumption.do_nothing_consequence: Future durable adapters would lack a tested idempotency and record-shape contract for suite metadata.
M1_challenge_assumption.upstream_fix_rejection_reason: Shared cloud storage providers exist, but this missing seam is Enterprise Suite metadata repository behavior rather than provider object storage.

findings: This advances the Enterprise Suite beyond DTO/OpenAPI/runtime route foundations toward later cloud integration without pretending durable storage exists.
Names follow Enterprise Suite storage adapter, in-memory, idempotency, and metadata record vocabulary.
Enterprise Suite spec, plan, todo, evidence, catalog, and audit-chain references were updated.
Storage-specific code lives in a new Enterprise Suite adapter crate; runtime/API/app/domain behavior remains unchanged.
No database migration, provider SDK, HTTP framework, runtime write integration, Workflow client, OpenTofu executor, child-service client, cloud adapter, or audit emitter was introduced.
No new third-party dependencies were added; the crate depends only on existing Enterprise Suite app/domain crates plus a test-only data-boundary kernel.
Stored records include schema_version and stable topic/idempotency fields; no wire API schema is changed.
Persistence helpers deterministically map existing domain/app envelopes into record views and then enforce key validation/duplicate checks before insert.
